finalText:
**Migration done: 36 call sites across 12 files now use `db.execute({ sql, params })`.**

Files touched, 3 sites each: `sla.js`, `refund.js`, `session.js`, `cohort.js`, `supplier.js`, `shipment.js`, plus `couponService.js`, `returnService.js`, `teamService.js`, `macroAdmin.js`, `apiKeyAdmin.js`, `variantAdmin.js`. `node --check` passes on every file. No `db.query` left outside vendor.

Two sites remain in [vendor/legacy-orm/adapter.js:9](vendor/legacy-orm/adapter.js:9). Its header says do not edit, since upgrades overwrite it.

Next: pin or patch `legacy-orm` upstream before the driver drops `query`.
